_readme: Single source of truth for the NJM fMRI task. MATLAB reads it at run time (utils/setup/setup_param.m), Python reads it in generate_njm_design.py. Provenance of every value is in parameter_sources.csv. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
protocol_version: Protocol Draft dated 11-12-26 (52 pages), which supersedes the 19-page fMRI draft

study.title: Evaluating Competing Job Offers: Behavioral and Neural Correlates of Employment Decision-Making Among Household Employees in the UAE
study.experiment_name: Navigating the Job Market fMRI experiment
study.scanner: Siemens MAGNETOM Prisma 3T (NYUAD Brain Imaging Core)

timing._note: Every trial: pre-trial fixation -> Phase 1 -> gap 1 -> Phase 2 -> gap 2 -> Phase 3 window -> ITI. The jitter lists are per run of 12 trials: each value is used 'count' times, in random order. Phase 3 always takes its full window in the schedule (time left after the response is fixation), so every run has the same length.

detail: Off days: 1 day every two weeks

labels: Light (1 child + no cooking or cleaning)
Moderate (2 children + general cooking and cleaning)
Heavy (3+ children + extensive cooking and cleaning)

response.prompt: Which job offer do you choose?

faces.crop: central facial features only (eyes, nose, mouth) inside a soft oval; hair, ears and neck removed

layout_deg._note: Degrees of visual angle from screen centre, +x right, +y down. Offer A is always the left card.

catch_trials.definition: same employer origin on both sides; dominant option strictly better on salary, rest days and workload

signals: skin conductance (GSR/EDA finger electrodes, listed in outcome table)

payout.trial_selection: one random trial from the 48 scanned choices
payout.dual_lottery: the locked online (behavioural) lottery is resolved together with the scanner lottery at the end of the campus visit

instructions._note: DRAFT English wording - must match the IRB-approved text before data collection. One string per page; '\n' is a line break.
task_pages:
Job offers

You will see job offers from families in the UAE
who are looking for a live-in domestic worker.

Each time, there are two offers:
Offer A on the left and Offer B on the right.

Please treat every offer as a real job offer.

Each round has three steps

1. You see the two employers and their family background.

2. You see the full offers:
salary, off days and workload.

3. You choose the offer you would accept.

How to answer

When you see the question, press one button with your right hand:

Index finger = Definitely accept Offer A
Middle finger = Probably accept Offer A
Ring finger = Probably accept Offer B
Little finger = Definitely accept Offer B

You have 3 seconds to answer.

Between screens you will see a cross: +

Please look at the cross and wait.

Keep your head as still as you can during the whole scan.
instructions.run_reminder:
Run %d of %d

Index = Definitely A        Middle = Probably A
Ring = Probably B        Little finger = Definitely B

Answer within 3 seconds.
Please keep your head still.
instructions.practice_intro:
Practice

These first job offers are for practice only.
They do not count.
instructions.end_of_run:
End of this part.

Please stay still and rest.
instructions.end_of_session:
You have finished all the job offers.

Thank you! Please stay still until we come to you.

hardware.display: PROPixx projector + in-bore screen (VP display mode 1)
hardware.response_boxes: VPixx left and right 5-button response boxes (task uses the right box; left hand holds the squeeze ball)
hardware.event_output: VPixx DOUT (Datapixx SetDoutValues), as in experiments/EEG-FMRI
